mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect overcast skies and 45 degrees at Fireman's Park. The overnight low will drop to 37 degrees with no rain predicted for the rest of the night.

The city is currently working on the Military Ridge State Trail paving project to improve year-round access for everyone, and officials are also accepting candidate registration for the upcoming 2027 Spring Election.

Today features live music at Paddy Mac's and yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at The Mill and The Bogey Factory, or head to the ART House for their Thursday night series.
On October 25, officers responded to an intersection where they found a 40-year-old man behind the wheel, resulting in an arrest for his first O W I offence.
Today's delicious flavor is Chocolate Caramel Twist. The store is currently open, but please note that they will be closing soon at 10 PM tonight.
